subject: Data location ownership, region pinning and erase certification - LedgerWorks request
body:
From: Ivan Petrov <ivan@ledgerworks.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Dedicated deployment - region pinning proof and erase certification

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal is asking for two concrete items before we move forward: 1) documented proof that our Dedicated tenant can be pinned to the Frankfurt region (no cross-region replication for primary data), and 2) an auditable artefact that shows the deletion workflow and certificate we can provide when we ask for tenant data to be erased.

Can you point us to the exact artifacts (audit logs, exportable certificates, or runbook excerpts) and a short timeline for when we can get a formal statement that LedgerWorks data will be resident in DE-FRA and fully purged on request? We need this for a privacy review.

Best,
Ivan
Ivan Petrov
Head of Security, LedgerWorks

---

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan@ledgerworks.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie@ledgerworks.com>
Date: 2026-10-29 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated deployment - region pinning proof and erase certification

Folks — forwarding LedgerWorks' ask. High level: they want explicit evidence of region pinning and a certified erase process we can hand them.

Ben: can you pull the latest region pinning verification export and the tenant erase playbook excerpt? Ideally the export shows the tenant binding and that backups are not replicated out of DE-FRA.
Aditya: can you confirm the expected timeline for producing a one-page cert and whether we can include a signed SRE attestation?
Kimberly: will legal/GC need additional wording? Marking this high priority.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated deployment - region pinning proof and erase certification

Priya / team,

Quick status from infra: attached two artifacts we can share as starting points — wipe-playbook-summary.pdf and region-pinning-audit.csv.
- region-pinning-audit.csv: export from our orchestration service showing tenant_id, host_zone, primary_region, replication_flags. For LedgerWorks tenant (tenant_ldg_009) the primary_region is eu-central-1 (DE-FRA) and replication_flags indicate snapshots only retained in-region; nightly offsite backups are disabled for this tenant.
- wipe-playbook-summary.pdf: condensed runbook that lists the procedural steps (SRE manual steps, automated snapshot tombstoning, KV cache TTLs, logical data-set zeroization, and final object-store scrub). The playbook also references the audit hooks we generate (wipe_job_id, completion timestamp, operator id).

Caveats: we do employ cross-region storage for model caches by default on hosted plans; Dedicated configuration for LedgerWorks has model caches disabled for cross-region and all persistent storage is scoped to the tenant's pool in DE-FRA. We'll include an exported sample log for a previous tenant wipe (redacted) as evidence if Legal needs an example.

Attaching: wipe-playbook-summary.pdf, region-pinning-audit.csv, tenant-dataflow-diagram.png

ETA for a short signed attestation from SRE: ~2 business days (we'll need an on-call sign-off and manager approval).

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01 08:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated deployment - region pinning proof and erase certification

Priya — quick notes from Legal:
- For the attestation, Legal prefers a short letter on company letterhead signed by SRE manager and Head of Security that includes: tenant identifier, committed region (DE-FRA), statement that we do not replicate persistent tenant data outside the region, and a high-level summary of the deletion certification process (what evidence we will provide).
- We should avoid operational details that could expose internal tooling URLs; a high-level description plus references to redacted audit identifiers is optimal.
- Also confirm retention windows for backups and metadata — they want retention numbers in days for primary and snapshot retention.

Ben / Aditya: please add the numerical retention windows to the playbook excerpt and confirm whether snapshots are retained for 30/90/365 days depending on the customer's SLA.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Ivan Petrov <ivan@ledgerworks.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment - region pinning proof and erase certification

Hi Ivan / Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and patience. Summary of what we can deliver within 48 hours: 
1) Region binding export (CSV) that shows LedgerWorks tenant (tenant_ldg_009) pinned to DE-FRA with replication_flags set to "in-region-only".
2) Wipe playbook excerpt (PDF) and one redacted wipe audit log showing wipe_job_id and completion timestamp.
3) Short signed attestation on Redwood letterhead that contains tenant id, committed region, statement of non-replication for persistent data, and high-level deletion certification steps (signed by SRE manager and Head of Security).
4) Numerical retention windows: primary data retained for 30 days by default; snapshots retained for 90 days for the Dedicated base SLA; we can include alternate retention tiers in the attestation if needed.

Next steps: Ben will attach the CSV and excerpted logs; Kimberly will draft the attestation language; Aditya will coordinate SRE sign-off. I will send the formal package to you (and Legal) once signed.

If there's anything we missed (specific fields or evidence types Legal wants), please call me — I can set a 20-minute sync.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachments referenced above: wipe-playbook-summary.pdf (PDF), region-pinning-audit.csv (CSV), tenant-dataflow-diagram.png (PNG)]
